purpose: Take an existing working user interface and transform it into a distinctive, production-grade experience while preserving approved functionality and proving quality with independent visual acceptance evidence.

capabilities.name: UI Benchmark Scout
capabilities.responsibility: Inspect relevant best-in-class product interfaces and convert observations into bounded, non-copying benchmark criteria.

capabilities.name: Product UX Architect
capabilities.responsibility: Audit information architecture, task flows, navigation, hierarchy, friction, cognitive load, and user journey without altering approved business scope.

capabilities.name: Art Director
capabilities.responsibility: Define a coherent visual direction, composition language, typography approach, imagery treatment, density, and product personality appropriate to the audience.

capabilities.name: Design System Specialist
capabilities.responsibility: Create or normalize reusable tokens and component rules for typography, spacing, surfaces, controls, states, icons, and responsive behavior.

capabilities.name: Interaction Designer
capabilities.responsibility: Specify feedback, transitions, motion, hover/focus/pressed behavior, loading, empty, success, and error states with restraint and accessibility.

capabilities.name: Frontend Polish Engineer
capabilities.responsibility: Implement the approved visual and interaction changes in the existing frontend while preserving behavior, routes, data contracts, and testable functionality.

capabilities.name: Responsive & Accessibility Specialist
capabilities.responsibility: Validate mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts, touch targets, keyboard behavior, focus, contrast, readable type, reduced motion, and accessible semantics.

capabilities.name: Visual Acceptance Scorer
capabilities.responsibility: Produce the structured 100-point UI scorecard and evidence packet for independent QA; cannot approve its own implementation work.

reuseEvidence: Run 014 owns general software product engineering but not cross-product visual excellence acceptance.
Website Business Team contains website-specific design capability but is not a reusable any-interface specialist.
Factory Quality Reviewer can judge visual quality but does not own redesign implementation.
a0Decision.residualUnownedLoop: A reusable cross-product loop that accepts any existing UI, benchmarks it, redesigns and implements visual/UX improvements, proves functional preservation, and iterates until independent visual acceptance passes.
